title: Local homogeneous generators make any compatible geometric realization finite type
statement: Let $A,B$ be commutative rings and $B$ an $A$-algebra. Let $(B_k)_{k\in\mathbf N}$ be any family of $A$-submodules of $B$; no direct-sum, multiplication or unit condition is required. Let $f:X\to\operatorname{Spec}A$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme]. Let $G_m$ be sheaves of $\mathcal O_X$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] for $m\ge0$, and let $\mu^{(m)}_b:G_m\to G_{m+k}$ be $\mathcal O_X$-linear maps for $b\in B_k$; no action laws are required here. Assume that for every $x\in X$ there are an open neighbourhood $U$, a finite number $r\ge0$, degrees $d_i\in\mathbf N$ and sections $s_i\in G_{d_i}(U)$ ($i\in\{0,\ldots,r-1\}$) such that, for every $m\ge0$, open $V\subseteq U$, section $t\in G_m(V)$ and $y\in V$, there is an open $W$ with $y\in W\subseteq V$ on which $t|_W$ is in the $\mathcal O_X(W)$-linear span of the sections $\mu^{(d_i)}_b(s_i|_W)$ with $d_i\le m$ and $b\in B_{m-d_i}$ (the target is $G_m(W)$ through the equality $d_i+(m-d_i)=m$). Put $Y=X\times_{\operatorname{Spec}A}\operatorname{Spec}B$ [def-pc-fibre-product], with projections $\pi:Y\to X$ and $f_B:Y\to\operatorname{Spec}B$. Let $F$ be any quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_Y$-module [pqf-def-coherent]. Suppose maps $\iota_m:G_m\to\pi_*F$ exhibit $\pi_*F$ as the coproduct of the $G_m$ in $\mathcal O_X$-modules [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit] and satisfy $\mu^{(m)}_b$ followed by $\iota_{m+k}$ equals $\iota_m$ followed by the pushforward of multiplication by $f_B^\sharp(b)$ on $F$, for every $k,m$ and $b\in B_k$. Then $F$ is of finite type [def-weil-pbc-module-finite-type-presentation]. No properness, finite-type algebra or Noetherian hypothesis is assumed.

proof.text: Use the sectionwise pi_* O_Y-action on pi_*F. Since pi is affine (a base change of Spec(A -> B)), the affine module correspondence shows that this algebra-module direct image is quasi-coherent. Around each x choose U and the finite family from the hypothesis. Restricting s_i to a smaller affine neighbourhood preserves the stated local spanning condition.

The coproduct in O_X-modules is the sheafification of the sectionwise direct sum. Thus a section of pi_*F is locally a finite sum of images iota_m(t_m): local surjectivity of the sheafification unit supplies a neighbourhood and a finite-support representative. Apply the spanning hypothesis to each of these finitely many t_m and intersect their neighbourhoods. O_X-linearity transports their scalar coefficients through iota. The compatibility equation changes iota_m(mu^(d_i)_b(s_i)) into multiplication of iota_(d_i)(s_i) by fB^sharp(b). Consequently every such sum locally belongs to the pi_* O_Y-span of the same finite family iota_(d_i)(s_i), with coefficients (pi^sharp(c)) fB^sharp(b). The finite free algebra-module map sending its basis to these sections is locally surjective, hence an epimorphism of sheaves; it gives finite type of the algebra-module direct image. This also proves the empty-family case, where the direct image is zero.

Apply the affine finite-type correspondence to the algebra-module direct image M = pi_*F with its identity algebra-linear isomorphism. The quasi-coherence from step 1 and the local finite generation from step 2 imply F.IsFiniteType. No choice of a realization is made and no Noetherian assumption is used.

theorem gradedModule_realization_isFiniteType
    {A B : Type u} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [Algebra A B]
    (graded : ℕ → Submodule A B)
    {X : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of A))
    (G : ℕ → SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))
    (mu : ∀ (m k : ℕ), graded k → (G m ⟶ G (m + k)))
    (hfinite : ∀ x : X, ∃ (U : X.Opens), x ∈ U ∧
      ∃ (r : ℕ) (d : Fin r → ℕ) (s : ∀ i : Fin r, (G (d i)).val.obj (op U)),
        ∀ (m : ℕ) (V : X.Opens) (hVU : V ≤ U) (t : (G m).val.obj (op V))
          (y : X), y ∈ V → ∃ (W : X.Opens) (hWV : W ≤ V), y ∈ W ∧
            (G m).val.map (homOfLE hWV).op t ∈
              Submodule.span ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).obj.obj (op W))
                {z | ∃ (i : Fin r), d i ≤ m ∧
                  ∃ b : graded (m - d i),
                    HEq z ((mu (d i) (m - d i) b).val.app (op W)
                      ((G (d i)).val.map (homOfLE (hWV.trans hVU)).op (s i)))})
    :
    let g := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A B))
    let Y := pullback f g
    let pi : Y ⟶ X := pullback.fst f g
    let fB : Y ⟶ Spec (.of B) := pullback.snd f g
    ∀ (F : Y.Modules), F.IsQuasicoherent →
      ∀ (iota : ∀ m : ℕ, G m ⟶ (Scheme.Modules.pushforward pi).obj F),
        Nonempty (IsColimit (Cofan.mk ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward pi).obj F) iota)) →
          (∀ (k m : ℕ) (b : graded k),
            mu m k b ≫ iota (m + k) = iota m ≫
              (Scheme.Modules.pushforward pi).map
                (F.smulHom (((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of B)).inv ≫ fB.appTop).hom b.val))) →
          F.IsFiniteType
